falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 73% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held above 5,000; this would signal the current structure is weaker and not a valid analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 28.6; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation beyond the pattern's stress parameters, proving this is a different regime (liquidation event vs. orderly bottom)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; the August 2024 bottom featured yields stable/rising with equities stabilizing, so this divergence breaks the pattern's macro coordination

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
